## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) spots [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) driving off in his best clothes, which piques her curiosity. She visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to fetch an orphan boy they are adopting to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel voices strong disapproval and concern over the risks of taking in a stranger child before departing to spread the news.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)_

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in seeking help for [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup while her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with children to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), saving her life, which leads Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to be best friends once again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that her eyesight is failing, prompting her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to let the home be sold, revealing her decision to forgo her college scholarship and remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to teach and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school position for her, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and become close friends with him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, observing her new pupils and feeling a special connection with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an eccentric parent, Mrs. Donnell, confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about how her children's names are pronounced and used. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her experience with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), remaining determined to win over the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), even as she prepares for her new journey.
>
